Future Foundation

Future Foundation is a charity foundation website with public informational pages, donation campaigns, reports, news, partners, FAQ, feedback/comments, and a small admin panel for editors and admins.

Primary public entry points
- /index.html: Homepage. Best starting point for understanding the organization, active fundraising, impact stats, events, FAQ highlights, and contact form.
- /about.html: About the foundation, mission, and organization overview.
- /campaigns.html: Public fundraising campaigns and donation opportunities.
- /cases.html: Impact cases, outcomes, and completed support stories.
- /posts.html: Public news archive.
- /post.html?slug={slug}: Individual news article page.
- /reports.html: Public financial and activity reports.
- /partners.html: Partner organizations and collaboration information.
- /faq.html: Frequently asked questions.
- /feedback.html: Public feedback and threaded comments page.

Suggested navigation order for language models
1. Start at /index.html for a broad summary.
2. Use /about.html for organization context.
3. Use /campaigns.html for active fundraising.
4. Use /reports.html for transparency and accountability.
5. Use /posts.html and /post.html for recent updates.
6. Use /faq.html when answering operational questions.
7. Use /feedback.html for public discussion context.

Content guidance
- Treat public pages as user-facing website content.
- Prefer public pages over admin pages when summarizing the project.
- Donation and campaign information is primarily surfaced on /index.html and /campaigns.html.
- Reports and transparency information are primarily surfaced on /reports.html.
- News content is primarily surfaced on /posts.html and /post.html.

Admin and non-public areas
- /admin-login.html: Admin sign-in page.
- /admin-posts.html: Admin post dashboard.
- /admin-post-editor.html: Admin post editor.
- /admin/* redirects to the admin HTML pages above.

API surface
- Public read endpoints live under /api/* for campaigns, posts, reports, partners, FAQ, activities, help options, comments, and related content.
- Admin and authentication endpoints also live under /api/* but are not public navigation targets.

Preferred indexing behavior
- Public pages may be indexed and summarized.
- Admin pages and admin/auth endpoints should not be treated as public destination pages.
